episode_title: Non-Alcoholic Beers and the Importance of Water Quality

real_qa.q: What are the main brewing methods to produce non-alcoholic beer with less than 0.5% ABV?
real_qa.r: You can adjust mash temperature to change the enzymatic profile and emphasize sugars that don't ferment well. Another method uses specialized yeast engineered to not produce alcohol while still giving off ethyl acetate for flavor. A third way is arresting fermentation by dropping temperature or mechanically removing yeast via centrifuge. Since non-alcoholic beer retains residual fermentable sugars, pasteurization is critical to prevent cans from exploding if fermentation restarts when warmed.
